changes.detail: Verified and saved lecomax-learning-app/artifacts/lecomax-learn-1.0.5-build7.apk, providing the native Live Kali Wi-Fi WebView screen. The local web app supplies the current text-entry bar and Enter/Tab/Esc controls.
Recovered the Android application build from Gradle Metaspace exhaustion with temporary JVM memory overrides. No permanent build configuration changes and no deployment.
Expanded keyboard regression coverage and appended linked preparation, failure and verification reports; all earlier reports remain intact.

summary: Keyboard interaction, access controls, typechecks and lint passed. The signed Android 1.0.5/build 7 APK was produced and verified after the memory retry.

validation.name: App and backend
validation.detail: Both TypeScript checks passed. Focused lint passed for KaliDesktop native/web, TeacherLab native/web, the Kali route and Wi-Fi URL validation.

validation.name: Interaction and access
validation.detail: Two desktop tests passed, including accented/Arabic/emoji key transmission, Enter/Tab/Esc, clearing and disabling text controls, reconnect cleanup and late-session cleanup. API probes returned 401 OWNER_LOGIN_REQUIRED and 403 LOCAL_LAB_ONLY as expected.
